{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows strong bearish signals (e.g., -0.25 or below).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 5-7 days show upward momentum, avoid overcorrection downward.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly below 30-day moving average, slightly raise it; if above, reduce.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish (e.g., 0.00–0.25) to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is rising while forecast is flat or falling, adjust upward by 5–10% of recent trend magnitude.",
    "Avoid overshoot after sharp spikes: if model forecasts a spike followed by a drop, cap the subsequent decline to prevent overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is bullish (e.g., 0.50+), allow forecast to slightly exceed recent highs but cap at 10–15% above to avoid overbought conditions."
  ]
}
